newsitem.title: JAPAN: CWB agrees to sell 1.2 mln T of wheat to Japan.
newsitem.headline: CWB agrees to sell 1.2 mln T of wheat to Japan.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board (CWB) on Wednesday agreed with the Food Agency of Japan to sell 1.2 million tonnes of wheat and 600,000 tonnes of feed barley in the 1997 calendar year, a source close to the agency said.
In previous year, the CWB had agreed with Japan to export 1.2 million tonnes of wheat and 500,000 tonnes of feed barley.
The supply agreement with Japan for wheat and barley is usually negotiated in November.

The Food Agency is the grain trading arm of the Agriculture Ministry. In Japan wheat and barley imports are solely handled by the agency, which carries out a weekly import tender for the grains every Thursday.
